name: 2.5 Measures of the Center of the Data
_note: In progress -- 5 of a planned 12, not pushed. The distinctive skill here is estimating a mean from a GROUPED table using class midpoints, which nothing in the bank covered; class boundaries are constrained so no seed produces a recurring midpoint. Three slots are reused. Still to write: a weighted mean, the mean of a sample against the mean of a population, and more practice separating the three measures of centre.

questions.title: Mean from a Grouped Frequency Table - Estimate the mean of data grouped into class intervals using class midpoints, and identify why the result is an estimate
Mean, Median and Mode from a Frequency Table - Compute the sample mean, median and mode from a frequency table, then identify which measure resists an added extreme value
Compute Mean from Fifty Values - Given 50 state-level mean commute times, compute the overall mean
Mean, Median, IQR, and Range from a Small Data Set - Compute four summary statistics from a randomized list of 9 values
Choose a Resistant Measure for a Skewed Distribution - Decide whether to report the mean+SD or median+IQR based on shape, then explain why
